sources.title: Study guide for Exam AI-200: Developing AI Cloud Solutions on Azure
sources.shortSummary: Fresh MCP retrieval confirms the unchanged undated four-domain, nine-skill, 27-subskill AI-200 outline and its stated weights. The original undated content identity is retained; this retrieval does not establish exam GA status or implementation behavior.

sources.title: Explore Azure Service Bus concepts and messaging in AI architectures
sources.shortSummary: Broker queues absorb bursts and decouple request intake from processing. Standard and Premium have different capacity models. Queue allocation is not exactly-once processing; reliability claims use the separate receive-mode unit.

sources.title: Process messages reliably
sources.shortSummary: PeekLock and receive-and-delete trade settlement reliability for overhead. Complete, abandon, defer and dead-letter serve distinct outcomes. Delivery limits, explicit DLQ resubmission and lock renewal are documented; renewal does not guarantee exactly-once effects.

sources.title: Configure delivery and retry policies for reliable event processing
sources.shortSummary: Traditional custom-topic webhook delivery uses acknowledgement, endpoint-specific error treatment, time and attempt limits, optional Blob dead-letter storage and all-or-none batches. Selected claims exclude the introductory overgeneralization that every unsuccessful status retries.

sources.title: Manage secrets and configuration in Functions
sources.shortSummary: Local settings are separate from hosted app configuration. Fetching remote settings and local machine encryption support development workflows. Questions do not make immediate refresh claims about centralized configuration or secret references.

sources.title: Azure Functions developer reference guide for Python apps
sources.shortSummary: Python v2 route_params reads route segments; blueprints must be registered with the main app. requirements.txt drives remote dependencies, .funcignore excludes deployment files, and changing Python version requires rebuilding and redeploying artifacts. Preview or new worker-version controls are excluded.

sources.title: CloudEvents v1.0 schema with Azure Event Grid
sources.shortSummary: The explicit compatibility table permits CloudEvents-to-CloudEvents and both Event Grid input output formats, but not CloudEvents input to Event Grid output. Candidate claims do not use the article’s old Functions runtime samples.
